reason: Honestly, the mess of five apps is my actual problem, so I'd download the free version and poke at it. But I make about seven grand a year and I'm already paying for Spotify and a budgeting app, so another $6 a month isn't happening unless Quilt replaces something I already pay for.
objection: I already pay for a budgeting app that works. Moving all my stuff into a new app and trusting an AI to file it in the right place sounds like more work this semester, not less, and if it gets one thing wrong I'm back to checking three places anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few weeks on the free tier it actually let me cancel my budgeting app, so Plus costs me nothing extra, or if there was a student price around $2 to $3 a month.
